i1.title: Arabiyat Prestige Nyla Sherbet Eau de Parfum 80ml

  • Heart: Plum
  • Base: Musk, Sandalwood

  • Concentration: Eau de Parfum
  • Size: 80ml
  • Scent profile: Fruity · Sweet

Why you'll love it

  • A juicy strawberry and mandarin opening
  • A ripe, fruity plum heart
  • A soft musk and sandalwood base
  • Generous 80ml Eau de Parfum

Strawberry and mandarin first, then plum, finishing with musk and sandalwood.
